messages:
maria: quick check-in on max-batch / token-budget tuning across cards. seeing weird p99 regressions after last kernel tweak on H100. can folks share recent microprofile results and any KV-cache fragmentation observations?

perf-bot: microprofile snapshot attached:
```
card: H100 80GB | seq=1024 | mix=avg | kernel=matmul_v2_opt
throughput_tok/s=3620 | p50=6.1ms | p95=11.8ms | p99=28.4ms
mem_peak=39.1GB | kv_frag=12% | batch_pack_ratio=0.82
notes: kernel matmul_v2_opt falls back to slower path when pack_ratio>0.9
```

sam: saw the same yesterday. p99 spikes correlate with pack_ratio > 0.9 and a KV frag increase after the kernel-change. H100 seems more sensitive than A100. :eyes:

derek: quick numbers from my run yesterday (mixed small/long):
```
A10 40GB  | max_tokens_target=24k | seq=512  | throughput=2100 tok/s | p99=34ms | kv_frag=6%
T4 16GB   | max_tokens_target=12k | seq=256  | throughput=840 tok/s  | p99=92ms | kv_frag=9%
L4 24GB   | max_tokens_target=8k  | seq=128  | throughput=620 tok/s  | p99=120ms| kv_frag=4%
A100 80GB | max_tokens_target=64k | seq=1024 | throughput=4100 tok/s | p99=19ms | kv_frag=10%
H100 80GB | max_tokens_target=128k| seq=1024 | throughput=3600 tok/s | p99=28ms | kv_frag=12%
```

olivia: thanks. can you share how you computed max_tokens_target? we need the heuristic: per-card_mem_budget / avg_token_memory.

derek: simple pipeline: take usable_gpu_mem = total_mem - system_overhead - kernel_workspace (measured), then estimate avg_token_bytes from profiling (token_kv + activations). used conservative avg_token_bytes=~300B for seq 1024 mixes, then set soft target = floor(usable_gpu_mem / avg_token_bytes). then clamp to safety factor 0.75 for distros.

maria: we should standardize the process. proposal: for each card type run 3 seq profiles [32,256,1024], measure avg_token_bytes and kv_frag, then compute two targets: "soft" (0.75) and "burst" (0.95) with kernel-aware caveat: if pack_ratio>0.9 kernel may route to fallback - lower burst.

kai: Kernel selection note: the matmul_v2_opt change added a fast path that assumes contiguous KV layout. when pack_ratio high we hit scatter gather path, which increases latency and memory fragmentation. this is why p99 jumps for H100 where we push pack_ratio higher to hit larger token targets.

perf-bot: regression log (from build 2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-14):
- build 2026-03-10: baseline matmul_v1 | H100 p99 18ms for seq=1024 mix
- build 2026-03-12: matmul_v2_opt deployed | H100 p99 28ms at high pack_ratio (>=0.9)
- build 2026-03-13: small patch reduced fallback frequency but p99 still ~24ms
please see /prof/reports/4766999000 for raw traces.

sam: do we have experiment matrix proposals? i'd like to sweep pack_ratio threshold, kernel fallback threshold, and per-card soft/burst factors. keep tests short (2h per card) but cover seqs.

derek: suggested matrix:
- cards: [T4, L4, A10, A100, H100]
- seqs: [32,128,512,1024]
- pack_ratio targets: [0.6, 0.75, 0.85, 0.92] (this is the runtime packing target)
- soft_factor: [0.65, 0.75, 0.85]
- measure: throughput_tok/s, p50/p95/p99, mem_peak, kv_frag, kernel_fallback_rate

olivia: add one more metric: avg_kernel_dispatch_time and number of slow_paths_per_second. those map to CPU scheduler pressure too.

maria: agree. I want two immediate takeaways:
1) temporary rollback to matmul_v1 on the H100 fleet slice where pack_ratio routinely >0.9 (safety)
2) run the sweep Derek proposed but with prioritized cards: H100/A100 first, then A10, then T4/L4.

kai: for rollback we can gate by runtime flag and do canary on 5% of H100. deployment playbook: revert kernel flag, run small smoke tests, enable canary, monitor p99+kv_frag for 4h.

sam: i'll own the sweep orchestration (thanks). plan to post results as CSV and a short summary. estimate total runtime ~12h if parallel across clusters.

maria: perfect. action items:
- @kai: implement runtime flag for kernel fallback + canary plan (eta 6h)
- @sam: launch sweep with matrix above, push CSV to /prof/results/476700 (eta 12h)
- @derek: prepare per-card avg_token_bytes dump and current usable_mem numbers (eta 3h)
- @olivia: add kernel dispatch metrics to profiler and enable on canary (eta 4h)

perf-bot: acknowledged. will post perf deltas automatically into thread when results land. :rocket:

maria: thanks everyone. ping this thread with any blockers. we'll reconvene after the sweep to pick soft/burst defaults per card (and decide if H100 needs matmul_v1 fallback permanently).
